notes: MSCI China A 50 Connect Index daily closes (underlying of the HKEX MCA futures family) from the HKEX quote widgets. Flow: render the product prices page (bot-lenient www.hkex.com.hk) and extract the per-render LabCI token from the inline getToken stub, then JSONP www1.hkex.com.hk/hkexwidget/data/getchartdata2 — requests MUST carry qid=<ms> and a jQuery-style callback name (jQuery<digits>_<digits>); without qid the endpoint answers Tomcat 403 (probed 2026-10-26). Chart granularity is span/int-joint: span=6&int=4 serves ~6 months of DAILY bars, span=7&int=6 ~2 years of WEEKLY bars (rows [ts_ms, open, high, low, close, vol, x]; null-valued rows pad non-trading days). No browser/curl_cffi needed.
